title: Kissed by Midnight Dutch Carrots Pancake
description: A rich and springy Dutch dish featuring candied peel and a mortar-pestle-pound technique, ideal for a midnight craving.
instructions: In a mortar, pound the candied orange peel into a fine texture, if it is not already.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together the carrot puree, granulated sugar, melted butter, eggs, and the pounded candied orange peel.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a comal or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the comal.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, until the edges start to dry and the surface is speckled with bubbles.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.
